description: KPIECE (Kinodynamic Planning by Interior-Exterior Cell Exploration) grows a tree of motions for a robot that must obey its dynamics (a *kinodynamic* problem). It applies random controls and simulates them forward, so it needs no steering function and no state sampler. A grid over a low-dimensional *projection* of the state, for example the position, records where the tree has been: a cell with all its grid neighbours occupied is *interior*, any other cell is *exterior*, the frontier. KPIECE prefers exterior cells that are little covered and that gave good expansions, so the tree spreads quickly into new space. It is probabilistically complete (it finds a path with probability one, given enough time, if one exists) but not optimal, and it stops at the first motion that reaches the goal.
